answer: Proof of Personhood using cryptographically signed attestations mitigates Sybil attacks by tying agent identity to a unique biometric quill of data. In this vast ocean of network traffic, nodes must stake native tokens to validate their status, effectively raising the horizon of financial entry for bad actors. An attacker attempting to scale multiple fraudulent entities faces an exponentially increasing capital cost that renders high-volume identity spoofing economically irrational and technically unsustainable.
